description: This file is an include/configuration fragment for GCC multilib setup, primarily defining variables and a Python function to copy and modify configuration files based on build variables. It sets multilib options, processes configuration files, and handles architecture-specific setup for the GCC toolchain within a build system.

methods.name: gcc_multilib_setup
methods.description: Configures GCC multilib support by copying, modifying, and writing configuration files based on build variables and target architecture.
